reproduced_defects.explanation: Dimensional transfer gains were incorrectly documented as dimensionless.
Explicit tf and declarative TF through run had no control-host route.
A final progress callback could cancel while direct TF still returned success.
Retained TF scalars were unavailable to control assignments, conditions and user functions.

independent_evidence.scope: All four input/output quantity combinations, hierarchical current-source identity, resistance and current-divider gain equations; typed document round trips are consistency checks.
Divider gain 2/3, input resistance 3000 ohm, output resistance 2000/3 ohm; altered divider, differential voltage, temperature coefficient and open-input determinations.
Nine existing tests, including ngspice voltage/current transfer oracles, hierarchical sources and branch impedance conventions; no external simulator was newly executed for this batch.
ngspice 46 source classification uses the actual device type; its three-scalar result and output labels informed interoperability. No source implementation was imported.

delivery_contract: Explicit tf and declarative run use the existing engine solver and retain stable dataset identity, physical units and probe/source names.

All three retained values count against the cumulative core result budget before solving. Failed or cancelled execution publishes no dataset and consumes no ordinal, including final-progress cancellation.

CLI direct/control results, flat conversion units, failed-run rollback and ordered unbounded print output are covered. WASM documents, scalar metadata, finite windows and presentation limits are covered.

Finite parameter-style TF references resolve lazily in let/if/while expressions and user functions. Formal arguments take precedence; retained scalar names precede ordinary parameter fallback. Active unbounded reads remain errors in both expression dialects.
The existing expression evaluator handles host reads without eagerly copying datasets into parameter scopes. Dead IF branches, lazily parsed user functions and random draw order are retained.
sdk_migration: TransferFunctionResult::new takes an explicit gain_unit after gain; engine-produced units derive from actual V/I source and probe types.
Match ControlAnalysisResult::TransferFunction and publish ControlPresentation::scalars as well as kind; zero-based scalar positions refer to authored print order among scalars and traces.

CLI control-presentation JSON is version 2 when scalar determinations are present; finite-only presentations retain version 1. WASM presentation metadata adds scalar determinations with resultIndex and position.
development_corrections: Early core fixture assertions assumed lowercase parsed node labels; parser canonical uppercase labels were retained.

Two initial CLI fixture failures used a lowercase error assertion and a .data extension without an explicit conversion input format. Corrected assertions and --from now test the intended behavior; these were not product fixes.
Strict Clippy initially found collapsible_match in newly integrated analog-array operand mapping. ce1cb4578 applies a behavior-preserving pattern simplification; no lint was suppressed.
remaining_work: Eight of 29 control-host dispositions are implemented; 21 require execution or producer/orchestration semantics. C04c still includes PoleZero, Sensitivity, Stb, Sp, Disto and DcMatch.

Broader C04 option/binding/configuration, producer dependencies, resource/complexity and performance qualification remain. Direct dataset binding in other host-command argument evaluators and general reduction of multi-point datasets are not established by the scalar-control tests; let plus variable substitution is exercised.

Native default and selected optimized WASM configurations are covered; this record is not exhaustive transfer accuracy, whole-program or every-feature qualification. Numerical tolerances and existing performance gates were not relaxed.

CLI runtime qualification still uses Rust 1.95 because the earlier Rust 1.94/faer failure is unresolved. Previously recorded Rust compiler and wasm-bindgen runner incidents remain C14 work; later passing runs do not establish a root-cause fix.
All 15 packages retain their previous open/in-progress status.
documentation_follow_up: Corrected the TransferFunctionConfig transconductance example to use a zero-volt measurement source with a branch current; a resistor alone has no such branch unknown. No executable code changed in this documentation follow-up.

later_remote_integration.scope: The documentation publication also integrates this separate Verilog-A discrete-array commit. The recorded tests qualify source_revision above and do not claim qualification of this later implementation.
